crossRefs.note: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are…
Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe…
For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by…
But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you…
But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me, there.
For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the…
We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were…
that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…
that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

translations.web: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?
translations.bsb: for you are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and dissension among you, are you not worldly? Are you not walking in the way of man?
translations.kjv: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?
translations.asv: for ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you jealousy and strife, are ye not carnal, and do ye not walk after the manner of men?
